snippet.title: NOMIA Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist and purchase on Steam here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3608900/NOMIA/

Coordinate two heroes in this story-rich tactics roguelike, releasing May 31st, 2026.

Set up combos with your reliable Action cards, execute masterstrokes by drawing the right Gambit cards, and blast monsters off cliffs. Chase salvation with cloth and steel. Chart the path through a shattered dream. 

Music by Will Goss: https://willgoss.com/
